Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the sources and selected an incorrect death year (1996) for Léo Joannon from a faulty Wikipedia snippet, ignoring multiple results on the same page indicating 1969. This unresolved source conflict led to the wrong conclusion that Excursion Train’s director died later than Bad Day at Black Rock’s director, whereas John Sturges actually died later (1992 vs. 1969).
